new_issues.title: [Executor] A failed write after journaling wedges the target until manual repair
new_issues.body:
## Problem

After the write is journaled, any non-zero `kubectl patch` exit raises `WriteOutcomeUnknown` (`services/executor/kubernetes_adapter.py:191-192`). `_reconcile` in `services/executor/core.py` then returns `NEEDS_RECONCILIATION` unless it finds a positive match (`core.py:124-140`). A harmless rejected patch therefore blocks the target until someone edits the SQLite store.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A regression test that fails on main: a rejected patch with an unchanged resourceVersion ends in a terminal state without manual edits.
- [ ] No second write is attempted for the same action.
- [ ] A write that did land is still recognised as applied.

Roadmap items: P1.10, P1.11. Related: #61.

new_issues.title: [Integration] Agent mode records a pre-authorized approval instead of using the approval boundary
new_issues.body:
## Problem

In agent mode the model's proposal is approved without a person: `experiments/boutique/harness/agent_live.py:232` records `operator_approval="pre-authorized local E2E test"`. The authenticated boundary in `runtime/approval_http.py` (#10) is not used on this path.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Agent mode waits for an approval through the authenticated boundary, or stops visibly without a write.
- [ ] Tests cover missing, expired and revoked approvals on this path.
- [ ] Docs say which demo paths are approved by a person.

Roadmap item: P2.02. Related: #10, #56.

new_issues.title: [Planner] Raw container log text reaches the model without filtering
new_issues.body:
## Problem

`export_telemetry` in `experiments/boutique/harness/agent_live.py` copies application log lines into the agent's input as written. A crafted log line could steer the diagnosis. With the pre-authorized approval in agent mode, that could lead to a rollback no person reviewed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Log text is bounded, quoted and marked as untrusted data in the model input.
- [ ] A test with an instruction-like log line shows it does not change the proposed action.
- [ ] A code-owned check, not the model, decides whether an action is allowed.

Roadmap item: P2.04. Related: #51, #56.

new_issues.title: [Planner] Agent mode bypasses the durable Planner journal
new_issues.body:
## Problem

`build_proposal` in `experiments/boutique/harness/agent_live.py` calls `propose_from_telemetry` directly. The model call is not recorded in `PlannerStore`, so the bounded attempts, exact replay and terminal ESCALATE added in #97 do not apply to agent mode.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Agent-mode planning runs through the Planner journal.
- [ ] A restart after a completed model call replays the saved proposal without another call.
- [ ] Model failures use the same attempt budget and end in a saved ESCALATE.

Roadmap item: P2.01. Related: #14, #54.

new_issues.title: [Runtime] Add structured logging to services, runtime and agent
new_issues.body:
## Problem

No module under `services/`, `runtime/` or `agent/` uses logging. Failures surface only in stored state or on stderr, and one action cannot be followed across processes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One shared JSON log format with the incident and action ids.
- [ ] State changes are logged after their transaction commits.
- [ ] No secrets or raw tokens in log output, with a test.

Roadmap item: P1.07. Related: #62, #63.
